Quill helps you rewrite emails, notes and messages in the tone you want.

- Rewrite text as friendly, formal or concise
- Share and discover writing templates from the community, with tools to report content and block users
- Export to Mail, Notes or any app

AI suggestions are generated by a third-party AI provider. Quill asks for your permission before any text is shared, and you can turn suggestions off at any time.

Quill Plus is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://quillwriter.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://quillwriter.app/privacy
